list.name: Changes
list.comment: Changing the format of the output.json so that contains both the day of the week and the date of the event

task.summary: Default task

Add tasks MinutesOfTheWeek() calculates the minutes of that time from the beginning of Monday OverlapTasks verifies if there is an overlap in the schedule of two tasks This tasks are not CSP variables because they are fixed values, but are used in the restriction to avoid overlaps The time is seen as a readable string and as a int to calculate the overlaps

Initialize the CSP model and solver All tasks that are fixed are considered interval var because they have a specific begin, duration and end All optional tasks (in this case Gym) have a domain of possible intervals that can take, it's the solver job to find a opening to fill, this "optional" will be set according to a bool_var that defines if the task exists The solver doesn't have still an objective, so the solution it gives is the one where it doesn't put gym anywhere
Merge with flexibleTasks
Adding weights to optimal tasks so that the solver prioritizes a tasks with higher priorities
Fixing bug where there was not any fixed tasks and giving a valid interval for optimal tasks
Adding a new optional task with variable duration, add restriction to verify start + duration = end but the model chooses the minimum time possible

Creating a new optional task of variable duration which is "Study in the Library", serves to see if multiple variables what is the parameters of the variable In this example, the library has a 9h to 16h schedule, but I don't want to be there before 10h, so the start domain is [10h, 16h]
Create function createNewOptionalTask() to create a new Optional Task and a dict that stores all information of every task
Creating a data Structure with all optional tasks and simplify the signature of the createNewOptionalTask() function
Create solveSchedule() and showInformation() to clean the rest of the code, the solver and show information part
Creation of a function that calls everything and is called in the beginning of the process
Now the solveSchedule verifies the status and only prints the information of the values if the status is OPTIMAL or FEASIBLE. Any other case prints error message
Changing order of the information of the solver values and status
Creating a JSON to store all the tasks, divided by fixed and optimal tasks
Changing the createNewOptionalTask to receive the JSON instead of the hardcode Python dict
Changing the fixedTasks to receive information from the JSON instead of the hardcoded Python dict
Creating function to create optional Tasks from the JSON
Changing minutesOfTheWeek function to receive the full task and calculate the minutes since the beginning of the week
Change fixedTasks() to receive only the fixed Tasks instead of all the JSON
Crates a JSON file (output.json) that stores all the tasks, in the correct schedule, divided into name, start and end (all tasks present have bool == 1)
Creating README.md and removing showInformation function
Updating README.md
Pushing into GitHub
Change fixedTasks to calculate minutes of the week sice the current time and defining when it will take place
Change addOptionalTasks() to calculate minutes of the week using the dateToMinutes function, also changing the dump in the output.json to write in paragraphs
Changing the format of the output.json so that contains both the day of the week and the date of the event
